title: Using naming convention token `referred_column_0_name` raises `sqlalchemy.exc.NoReferencedColumnError`

labels.name: schema
labels.description: things related to the DDL related objects like Table, Column, CreateIndex, etc.

labels.name: naming conventions
labels.description: things to do with the metadata.naming_convention feature

body:
### Describe the bug

Using naming convention token `referred_column_0_name` raises `sqlalchemy.exc.NoReferencedColumnError`

### To Reproduce

```python
from sqlalchemy import Column, ForeignKey, Integer, MetaData
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship

metadata = MetaData(
    naming_convention={
        "fk": "fk_%(referred_column_0_name)s",
    }
)

Base = declarative_base(metadata=metadata)


class Person(Base):
    __tablename__ = "persons"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)

    addresses = relationship("addresses", back_populates="person")


class Addresses(Base):
    __tablename__ = "addresses"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, nullable=False)
    person_id = Column(ForeignKey("persons.id"))

    person = relationship("persons", back_populates="addresses")
```
